title: World Generator: Produce Qualifying Social Events at Controlled Low Frequency
objective: Attach SocialEventSpec instances with qualifying event types (confrontation or withdrawal) to exactly three arc phase definitions in arcs.py, so that get_world_snapshot returns a non-None social_event on Days 4, 8, and 13 — enabling the T4 event-aware detection path (_detect_qualifying_t4_social_event) to fire during real simulation runs. All changes must be confined to the world layer (arcs.py only). No other file may be touched.
previous_attempt_failure_note: attempt_1 was rolled back because the executor mutated road_map.md, a canonical SOT file located at /home/even/projects/orchestration/agent_orchestrator/projects/cyber-community-v2/road_map.md. That file is owned by the orchestration system, not the codebase. Writing anything to any file outside /home/even/projects/cyber-community-v2/ is strictly forbidden. This must not happen again.
exact_scope: Modify back/app/world/arcs.py ONLY. Add a SocialEventSpec to the social_event field of three specific ArcPhase instances: Day 4 (Arc 1 Skepticism phase, day_offset=1), Day 8 (Arc 1 Recalibration phase, day_offset=5), and Day 13 (Arc 2 Debate Splits phase, day_offset=3). All other ArcPhase instances must retain social_event=None. The fallback cycle phases (_FALLBACK_PHASES) must not receive any social_event. The generator.py file does not need to change because WorldSnapshot.social_event is already populated from ArcPhase.social_event via the existing _snapshot_from_phase path — verify this flow is complete or add the single missing assignment if it is absent.
constraints: Only back/app/world/arcs.py (and back/app/world/generator.py if the social_event field is not forwarded to WorldSnapshot in _snapshot_from_phase) may be modified
No changes to back/app/domain/models.py, back/app/domain/enums.py, or any engine file
No changes to any file under back/tests/ — the test file test_p32_t2_generator_qualifying_events.py already exists and is the acceptance oracle
No changes to docs/vision.md, docs/road_map.md, docs/decisions_summary.md, or any decisions file
Absolutely no changes to any file outside /home/even/projects/cyber-community-v2/ — in particular /home/even/projects/orchestration/ is off-limits entirely
SocialEventSpec schema (in models.py) is frozen — do not add, remove, or rename fields
Qualifying event types must be SocialEventType.confrontation (Days 4 and 13) and SocialEventType.withdrawal (Day 8)
Total qualifying days in arc range 3–16 must be exactly 3: {4, 8, 13} — no more, no fewer
Fallback cycle days (Day 17+) must continue to produce social_event=None
All output must remain deterministic: same day input always yields same WorldSnapshot output
AppraisalSignal v1 shape is frozen — do not modify it
T4 old deterministic path remains frozen — do not add any gate or adversarial branch to activate it
Settlement remains engine-authoritative — no direct state mutation in world layer
acceptance_criteria: get_world_snapshot(4).social_event is not None and event_type == SocialEventType.confrontation
get_world_snapshot(8).social_event is not None and event_type == SocialEventType.withdrawal
get_world_snapshot(13).social_event is not None and event_type == SocialEventType.confrontation
Every arc day in range 3–16 that is NOT in {4, 8, 13} returns social_event == None
Every fallback day in range 17–31 returns social_event == None
Calling get_world_snapshot for any of the three qualifying days twice in a row always returns identical social_event values (determinism)
Running simulate_day_bridged on Day 4, 8, or 13 with a Vega relationship produces at least one T4ActivationAuditRecord with activated=True
Running simulate_day_bridged on Day 3 or Day 6 (no social event days) produces no T4ActivationAuditRecord with activated=True
The T4 activation rate over a 14-day live simulation of days 3–16 is greater than 0.0 and no more than 0.40
All existing tests in back/tests/ continue to pass without modification
required_tests: Day 4 snapshot has a social_event of type confrontation
Day 8 snapshot has a social_event of type withdrawal
Day 13 snapshot has a social_event of type confrontation
Non-qualifying arc days (3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16) each return social_event equal to None
Fallback days 17 through 31 all return social_event equal to None
Calling get_world_snapshot for a qualifying day twice returns the same social_event both times
A live simulation day on Day 4 with a Vega relationship activates the T4 event-aware path
A live simulation day on Day 8 with a Vega relationship activates the T4 event-aware path
A live simulation day on Day 13 with a Vega relationship activates the T4 event-aware path
A live simulation day on a non-qualifying day does not activate the T4 event-aware path
A 14-day live simulation from Day 3 to Day 16 produces a T4 activation rate strictly above zero and at most 0.40

Do not implement target_id routing or filtering on social_event.target_id
Do not expand the set of qualifying event types beyond confrontation and withdrawal
Do not add qualifying social events to more than 3 arc days
Do not change the T4 bridge architecture, settlement logic, or appraisal signal shape
Do not write any documentation or analysis files
Do not create new arc phases or change any narrative content
Do not modify the test file test_p32_t2_generator_qualifying_events.py
Do not touch any file in the orchestration directory tree
